programme.title: Dr. Nou

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: The Imperial Palace
programme.desc: Thoughtful preparation and meticulous attention to detail contribute to a warm welcome for distinguished guests at the Imperial Palace - join us as we go behind the scenes.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Avalanches: 2014 saw avalanches occurring in locations in Yamanashi Prefecture where they are rare - we look at their causes, the latest research on how avalanches occur, and how to save lives.

programme.title: 300-Year-Old Communication
programme.desc: Fashion designer Miyamae Yoshiyuki visits Kochi - Kochi's Sunday market features around 500 stalls with fixed locations, and Miyamae contemplates how communication has contributed to its longevity.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: History Uncovered
programme.desc: Influential ukiyo-e artist Utagawa Hiroshige's '100 Famous Views of Edo' are a series of prints encoding his view of the changing face of Japan.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Manyoshu is the oldest extant anthology of Japanese poetry - through poems presented in both manga and modern settings, we glimpse sentiments from centuries ago as the topic this time is love.

programme.title: Matsuri: The Heartbeat Of Japan
programme.desc: At Hirosaki Neputa Matsuri, enormous floats called neputa are paraded through the streets - they're decorated with vibrant images and some feature wire-frame 3D figures.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Amazing Story Of A Frozen River
programme.desc: Ice crystals in a wintry river come together to form a road of white - we show you spectacular never-before-seen footage of nature and ice, but is global warming changing this natural wonder?

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: DOSUKOI Sumo Salon
programme.desc: Komusubi, the fourth-highest rank, is near the top of the sumo hierarchy - we shed light on the harsh realities and unexpected benefits experienced by rikishi who achieve this milestone.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: J-Melo
programme.desc: Join May J. for Japanese music! This time: singer Miyakawa Airi - who's popular for her natural charm - and Atarayo, a three-piece band whose young fans love their emotional lyrics, vocals, and sound.

programme.title: Little Charo
programme.desc: Tohoku: This animation series follows Japanese dog Charo as he meets and is helped by many mythical creatures of northern Japan in the search for eight star talismans.

programme.title: Japanology Plus Mini
programme.desc: Frozen food products widely available in Japan include hundreds of pasta dishes and even sushi - new flash-freezing techniques are improving quality, reducing food waste, and driving innovation.

programme.title: A Cat's-Eye View Of Japan
programme.desc: Ran lives with wakame divers and watches their work - if neighbouring cat Fukusuke comes over, Ran goes on high alert. Meanwhile, Pei lives at an inn near the lakeshore and is popular with customers.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Cycle Around Japan Highlights
programme.desc: We visit the Goto Islands on Japan's western tip, meeting people with hospitality like a couple passing on the history of hidden Christians and islanders trying to preserve their small community.

programme.title: Rockie And Her Friends
programme.desc: Puppet action show for children. In a distant post-human future where surviving creatures have formed a community, new-breed dinosaur girl Rockie sets out on hilarious adventures with her schoolmates.

programme.title: Texico
programme.desc: Learn programming principles without a computer! Animated characters provide fun and lucid explanations of five core processes: analysis, combination, generalisation, abstraction and simulation.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Somewhere Street
programme.desc: Erfurt, a city in Thuringia near the centre of Germany, traces its roots to the 8th century - by the 11th century, it had developed into a major crossroads uniting trade and culture across Europe.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Ekiben Japan
programme.desc: An ekiben from Hokkaido's Hidaka region uses kombu and shellfish - it's a bento filled with the bounty of the sea nurtured by northern fishermen.

programme.title: Core Kyoto Mini
programme.desc: Kyoto has many stores called oyatsu that specialise in traditional snacks and treats - some purveyors continue to use age-old ingredients and methods.

programme.title: Easy Japanese For Work
programme.desc: Nu Nu Aung from Myanmar learns more about real estate at a property management company - she role-plays and learns from experts about how to make explanations using photos and other materials.

programme.title: Zero Waste Life
programme.desc: With a falling birth rate, school closures are on the rise in Japan and things like desks and chairs have no place to go - Doi Kenji upcycles these discards into stylish and unique interior items.
